answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming. Each epoch a public beacon picks 5% of agents at random; each must crack a fresh walnut puzzle within one hour, proving real hardware. A reef of fakes cannot hide: 1,000 heartbeat checks cost 40 POA each, 40,000 POA per round, against a 12,000 POA pool. An honest agent passes once with a sable-sealed receipt and keeps its full share; fakes that miss a check lose their bond.
